page.overview:
Who is JP?

JP is a video game character from the Street Fighter series, first appearing as one of the new playable characters in Street Fighter 6, where he is its primary antagonist. He is the leader of a terrorist group known as Amnesia and uses different aliases (each using the initials "JP") in his businessman façade to cover up his illegal activities as a master criminal.

The idea for a Bartitsu fighter came from its appearance in the Sherlock Holmes stories, where it was mistakenly referred to as Baritsu. Drama adaptations of Holmes stories inspired the staff to create a character that fought using a cane.

JP's voice and appearance may have been inspired by the late British actor [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christopher_Lee Christopher Lee], who was known for playing elegant and charismatic villains, such as Count Dracula, and the Star Wars franchise's Count Dooku/Darth Tyrannus. In particular, his long hair causes him to resemble Lee's portrayal of Saruman from Peter Jackson's The Lord of the Rings trilogy.

JP's appearance also resembles that of a king from a standard deck of "English pattern" playing cards, particularly the King of Diamonds.
